ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What part of the heart is under the Right Atrium?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The heart diagram shows labeled chambers and vessels. The upper blue chamber on the viewer’s left side is labeled E. Directly below that same blue chamber is a lower blue chamber labeled B. Reasoning: The question asks what part of the heart is under the Right Atrium. Following the diagram, the Right Atrium corresponds to the upper blue chamber labeled E, and the chamber directly under it is labeled B. By heart anatomy, that lower chamber is the Right Ventricle.
